Actual PDF indexes 2 and 4 supply the selected intercooled 2.2-litre SOHC inline four, 2213 cc, 8.5:1, five-speed manual, 175 advertised hp at 5300 rpm and 175 lb-ft at 2200–4800 rpm. Retain native advertised units without assuming net/gross or dyno output. The 12-psi figure is maximum boost, not a fixed operating pressure. Count the related original L-body Shelby/Dodge sporting-road programme conservatively once across Omni GLH/GLH-T/GLH-S, related Charger derivatives and names; no second badge, tune, body or ordinary Horizon count is added.
cars.summary: The Omni GLH-S established Shelby’s own turbocharged front-drive road-car programme.
